$schema_description: Template for config/aliases.json — copy this file to config/aliases.json and replace the example entries with your real data. The actual config/aliases.json is gitignored so personal data does not leak. Match rule: pairs are resolved by (author_name, author_email) lookup, not by primary-key id — safe across `bin/import.php --fresh`. In equivalent_domains the FIRST domain of each group is the preferred canonical domain when picking the surviving record.

pairs.note: same email, login vs full name
